title: Connect Codex to Xcode 27 with MCP
summary: Keremcan Yesildag separates Codex registration, Xcode external-agent access, headless permissions, and project approval while diagnosing an MCP bridge that reports disabled access. His walkthrough verifies the connection with scheme discovery and a focused documentation query before asking the agent to edit a project.
takeaway: Verify project approval and read-only MCP queries independently before debugging code changes; a registered bridge alone does not establish working Xcode access.
